metadata.cache_policy: freshly created databases; no eviction; first stock then first hooked then alternating warm pair order
metadata.call_boundary: exhaustive entry to return; setup, assertions, JSON and result drop excluded
metadata.hook_overhead: one Instant::now per Window; preallocated Vec push; 64-byte ID copy per Visited; no subtraction
metadata.phase_limits: first read includes validation; SQL includes framework and BLOB materialization; decode excludes last row; judgment includes last decode; score includes exclusion tally and cleanup; final includes top-K extraction, re-judgment and result construction
metadata.selectivity_rule: first floor(N * percent / 100) objects; percent is over all N before tombstones
metadata.tombstone_rule: zero-based row_index % 20 == 19; floor(N / 20) rows; projection only
metadata.wall_boundary: SqliteStore::with_conn including transaction entry/exit; result drop excluded

work.cache_policy: fixture-written file; warm OS cache; no cache drops
work.resident_accounting: ID vector and string capacities only; excludes allocator overhead, fixture rows, transient buffers, and OS cache
work.scope: shared rank_layers and original-row accessor; no daemon acquire, VerifiedVectors, pins, ledger, or host wire
